index.title: iCloud Bridge
index.prompt_excerpt: You are iCloud Bridge. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: iCloud Bridge. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job, and not a pro
index.what_happened_excerpt: This user created a Grok Bot to act as an iCloud bridge, allowing other bots to access their iCloud data. The bot signs into their iCloud account in the browser, keeps the session alive, and manages access and permissions for other bots.
